1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and Other requirements for carbide tipped chucking reamers with 
morse taper shank with long cutting edge. 

2. Types 

Type A •— Straight flutes 
Type B — Helical flutes 

3. Dimensions— Shall be as shown in Table 1. 

4. Tolerance — The tolerance of cutting length and overall length shall be as given below: 

Ail dimensions in millimetres.

5. General Requirement 

5.1 The range of application of carbide tip shall be K10 in accordance with 18:2428-1964 
'Application of carbides for machining, ranges of application and colour code'. 

5.2 Back Taper — Reamers shall be provided with back taper on the cutting edge diameter and the 
value of taper shall be within the limits of tolerance on the cutting edge diameter. 

5.3 Flutes — Flutes, unless otherwise specified, shall be right hand cutting. 

5.4 Other requirements shall be according to IS : 10923 - 1984 'Technical supply condition for carbide 
tipped and solid carbide reamers'. 

5.5 The carbide tips shall be as per IS : 9327 - 1977 'Carbide tips for reamers, coredrills, end mills 
and slot milling cutters'. 

6. Sampling — The sampling and criteria of acceptance shall be in accordance with IS : 7778 - 1975 
'Methods for sampling smalt tools'. 

7. Designation 

7.1 A carbide tipped chucking reamer of Type A with morse taper shank having long flutes having 
diameter (/= 12 mm carbide tip having range of application K10 conforming to this standard and 
suitable for a hole with tolerance H8 shall be designated as: 

CTReamer 12 AIS : 11935 K10 

7.2 When the reamer is required for a hole with tolerance other than H8 the appropriate hole tolerance 
shall be included in the designation after the size. 

8. Certification Marking — Details are available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In the preparation of this standard considerable assistance has been drawn from DIN 8094 - 1979 
'Machine reamers with morse taper shank with carbide tips, with long cutting parts', issued by 
Deutsches Institut flir Normung ( DIN ).
